# topology_ai_non_empty fixture

This fixture is static, hand-authored test data for PR44. It is not live AI
output and it must not be treated as model evidence.

The `responses/` directory contains one response file for each packet currently
generated by `TestProject` PR26. Most responses are empty completed fixtures.
`responses/12B-001.json` contains one accepted current-model extraction item
that exercises PR27 through PR37.

`approval-decisions.json` explicitly approves exactly one deterministic PR32
approval item produced from that response. The topology_ai driver never creates
this approval automatically.
